NativeOrbitalUnfoldingR33.ordered_gram_shell.{u_1} {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] (g : R) (c : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
  g * c 0 = g * c n - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, g * (c (k + 1) - c k)
